newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH EMU ENTRY WITHOUT SWEDEN SHEER MADNESS-MTK.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH EMU ENTRY WITHOUT SWEDEN SHEER MADNESS-MTK.

text.p: For the forest industry, Finnish membership of Europe's planned single currency would be sheer madness unless Sweden joined, too, the Finnish Central Union of Agricultural Producers and Forest Owners (MTK) said on Monday.
"From the Finnish forest industry's point of view it would be sheer madness if Finland joined the third stage of EMU without Sweden," MTK chaiman Esa Harmala told Reuters.
The U.S. dollar is the main invoicing currency for pulp and paper, and the Swedish crown is the central invoicing currency for mechanical forest industry products, he noted.

"The euro will not necessarily change this set-up," he said, adding: "The Finnish national economy has always suffered when the forest industry's (product) prices have fallen and when the invoicing currencies have fallen."
